permission.realcount.title: Allow Real Count?
permission.realcount.body:
Snapy uses Android’s Accessibility permission to:

• see which app is open, to show your screen time in the pill at the top
• count swipes in short-video feeds (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, Snapchat, Moj, Josh and more)
• go Back, Home or open Recents when you ask by voice

Everything is counted on your phone. Snapy never reads, stores or sends your messages, posts, passwords or anything else on your screen, and nothing is uploaded.

On the next screen, tap “Snapy Real Count” and turn it on.

oem.xiaomi.name: Xiaomi, Redmi, POCO (MIUI / HyperOS)
oem.xiaomi.steps:
Settings → Apps → Manage apps → Snapy → turn on Autostart.
Battery saver → No restrictions.
Open Recents, pull Snapy down and tap the lock.
oem.oppo.name: Oppo, Realme (ColorOS / realme UI)
oem.oppo.steps:
Settings → Battery → App battery management → Snapy → Allow background activity.
Settings → Apps → Auto launch → turn on Snapy.
Lock Snapy in Recents.
oem.vivo.name: Vivo, iQOO (Funtouch / OriginOS)
oem.vivo.steps:
Settings → Battery → Background power consumption → Snapy → Allow.
i Manager → App manager → Autostart → turn on Snapy.
Lock Snapy in Recents.
oem.samsung.name: Samsung (One UI)
oem.samsung.steps:
Settings → Apps → Snapy → Battery → Unrestricted.
Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → keep Snapy out of Sleeping and Deep sleeping apps.
Add Snapy to Never sleeping apps.
oem.oneplus.name: OnePlus (OxygenOS)
oem.oneplus.steps:
Settings → Apps → Snapy → Battery → Allow background activity.
Settings → Battery → Battery optimisation → Snapy → Don’t optimise.
Lock Snapy in Recents.

perm.counter.title: Reel counter
perm.counter.disclosure: Count Reels and Shorts. Never reads messages or what you type.
perm.counter.detail:
Snapy uses Android’s Accessibility permission to:
• see which app is open, to show your screen time in the chip
• count swipes in short-video feeds (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, Snapchat, Moj, Josh and more)
• go Back, Home or open Recents when you ask by voice, and tap Send when you confirm a WhatsApp message

Everything is counted on your phone. Snapy never reads, stores or sends your messages, posts, passwords or anything you type, and nothing is uploaded.

On the next screen, tap “Snapy Real Count” and turn it on.
perm.counter.without: Without it: screen time only, no reel numbers.

onb.restricted_body:
Snapy was installed as an APK, so Android asks for a one-time unlock before you can turn on the Reel counter:
1. Tap “Open App info”.
2. Tap ⋮ (top right).
3. Choose “Allow restricted settings”.
4. Come back here and tap “Agree and continue” again.

home.a11y_stopped_title: Your phone stopped Snapy's Reel counter
home.a11y_stopped_body: It's still switched on in Settings, but the phone closed it in the background. Turn it back on, then stop the phone from closing Snapy:
home.a11y_steps.oppo:
Settings → Battery → Snapy: allow background activity and auto-launch.
Open Recents and lock Snapy (pull its card down or tap the lock).
home.a11y_steps.xiaomi:
Settings → Apps → Snapy → Autostart: on.
Battery saver → No restrictions.
home.a11y_steps.samsung: Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps → add Snapy.
home.a11y_steps.vivo:
Settings → Battery → Background power consumption → Snapy: allow.
Lock Snapy in Recents.
home.a11y_steps.oneplus:
Settings → Battery → Battery optimisation → Snapy: Don’t optimise.
Lock Snapy in Recents.
home.a11y_steps.other: Settings → Apps → Snapy → Battery: Unrestricted (or “Don’t optimise”).
